item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.1.36.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.1.36/Leise-2.1.36.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.1.36
- **The first-launch window that listed all your apps is gone.** 2.1.35 greeted several of you with an inventory of every application on your Mac — that was a bug in the new install guard, and it's our fix to make, not your concern to read. Removed. What remains is quieter and only appears when it can actually help: if you start Leise from your Downloads folder, it now offers to complete the installation for you — moving itself into Applications and, if an older copy is in the way, moving that one to the Trash (recoverable) as part of the same click. Nothing is ever deleted on its own, and a properly installed Leise stays completely silent. - **The recordings dialog now just asks.** Same three choices with the same numbers (keep the last 7 days / keep everything / delete everything), without the long preamble. The full explanation of how Leise handles recordings stays where it belongs: Settings → Audio. - **Updates, on your terms.** Settings → General now has an "Check for updates automatically" toggle — off by default; when off, Leise never contacts the update server. There is also a "Check for Updates…" item in the Leise menu, which asks once whether you'd like automatic checks before performing its first check. Update checks fetch a version number from GitHub and never send information about your machine.
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** · about **7 GB free disk** (523 MB app + 5.9 GB speech models downloaded on first run).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
**macOS will refuse to open it once.** Leise is signed but not notarised. ⛔ **In both dialogs the blue default button is "Move to Trash"** — pressing Return deletes the app you just downloaded. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, find the line about Leise, and click **Open Anyway**. Full walkthrough in English, Deutsch and 简体中文: [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).
**What it sends over the network.** Nothing about you. Exactly three requests, all under your control: downloading the speech models on first run, and — only if you tick the box, which ships unticked — asking for a version number; plus the same version check when you choose "Check for Updates…" yourself.
Anything wrong: **Settings → General → Diagnostics → Export Diagnostics** writes a file to your Downloads folder. Send it over.
